facts.business: Mafatlal Industries Limited is a diversified solutions provider operating at the intersection of quality textiles and digital infrastructure, serving institutional requirements including uniforms, fabrics, healthcare, consumer durables, and digital infrastructure through an asset-light, vendor-based model.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Assessment of recoverability of deferred tax assets (DTA) of Rs 63.32 crores as at March 31, 2026, based on projected taxable profits involving significant judgement and inherent uncertainties in forecasting.

key_risks: Recoverability of deferred tax assets dependent on future taxable profits with inherent forecasting uncertainties
High customer concentration risk with Maharashtra Building and other construction workers welfare board contributing Rs 2,201.75 crore (over 10% of revenue)
Execution risk in transition from asset-heavy textile manufacturer to asset-light solutions provider
Dependence on government spending in education, healthcare, and digital infrastructure for institutional demand
facts.related_party_note: Strategic investments in subsidiaries: Rs 0.60 crore in Pieflowtech Solutions Private Limited (60% stake) on September 11, 2024 and Rs 0.51 crore in Mafatlal Apparel Exports Private Limited (51% stake) on July 19, 2025. Scheme of reduction and reorganization of capital approved by Board on November 14, 2022 with Appointed Date April 01, 2022.
